tests.name: The unit suite is green on head, including the unchanged accounting.test.ts. A pass of TP-1 in the verify attestation covers the unit command only and claims no int run. The int scenarios below run in CI test:int on the same head and are judged from that run and from the diff: each name is one exact, unique string literal in the diff, and the CI test:int output shows packages/core/src/quota/admin.int.test.ts passing with no skip and a test count that includes them (the CI reporter prints only some test names, so a name is not required to appear in the output). Names: «quota new period: an expired allocation gets a second period from the panel and one allocation_change row» (AC-1, AC-2, AC-5); «quota new period: the previous period keeps its row and its remainder does not carry over» (AC-1); «quota new period: an unclosed allocation that overlaps in time is refused with no write» (AC-4); «quota new period: an expired allocation that was never closed does not block a new period» (AC-4); «quota new period: the same request twice writes one period, and a changed request with the same key is refused» (AC-3); «quota new period: the initial pilot grant key and its refusals are unchanged» (AC-3); «quota set on an expired period: refused or clearly reported, with no usable-allowance claim» (AC-5); «quota new period: a caller without admin authority is refused with no write» (AC-6); «quota new period: after the new period a new reservation succeeds» (AC-7). The locked int tests (quota pilot, quota ledger, operator, charged-material, cross-account quota) stay green in the same CI run (AC-11). AC-8, AC-9, AC-10, AC-12 and AC-13 are judged from the diff and the report. AC-14 is judged from the report, the diff of docs/API_CONTRACTS.md and the PR text: current storage behaviour unchanged and stated
